_comment: The live record: a turn's record kept on disk while it runs (docs/CONTRACTS.md,
'Incremental record'). Found by root-causing P2G and M2 (C5, 2026-11-04): a run
killed at a benchmark's time cap left no gnomon-side record, because the task record
was printed and the turn record written only when the process exited normally.
19 of 21 capped cells in P2G attempt 1 and 20 capped cells in M2 had none.
KILL_SIGNALS, UNFINISHED_CODE and file suffix equal this file, and that a killed
record carries every key in required_keys. packages/gnomon-cli/src/live_record.test.ts
kills real `gnomon task` children with SIGTERM and SIGKILL and reads the records back.
format: one line of JSON: the TaskRecord shape `gnomon task --json` prints, plus the keys below; input and output follow [audit] record (omitted under metadata)

record_state.partial: the turn has not ended; rewritten after each model reply and each tool call; what a SIGKILL leaves
record_state.final: the turn ended, normally or by a caught signal; nothing rewrites it

stop_reason.killed: SIGINT, SIGTERM or SIGHUP ended the process mid-turn; stop_detail.signal names it

on_signal.stdout: gnomon task --json prints the killed record
on_signal.exit: the signal is raised again with the handler removed: the process dies of it, as it did before (143 for SIGTERM in a shell)
